name: Rizuhble's Goo Punch Viscous
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,000 (levels 1-14). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Goo Ball unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown. Ultimate (Goo Ball) is available from Compress Cooldown.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Compress Cooldown completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 7 to Splatter's damage (0.70x scaling).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Imbued on Splatter: widens its range.
items.why: imminent: Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Compress Cooldown completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Splatter: takes 18% off its 12s base cooldown.

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Grit, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Grit, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Melee Charge
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Crushing Fists, 19200 souls (~19.2 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)
items.legacy_note: Puddle Punch's damage scales with your melee damage.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,000-20,000 (levels 14-25). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Splatter T3, Puddle Punch T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Splatter, damage) grows from 136 to 264. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Grit.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 18 to Goo Ball's damage (1.00x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Lifestrike
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Grit completes 800 souls on. Upgrade of Melee Lifesteal (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Grit completes 4.8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Grit
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Splatter (249) clears its 165-damage trigger; Puddle Punch stays under it. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 10,400 to 12,000 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 189s; 20% off is 37.8s per full rotation.

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.why: vitality investment only; its 6.4k tier completes at Fortitude, 10400 souls (~10.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Puddle Punch (2 to 3).

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 20,000-49,600 (levels 25-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): The Cube T3, Goo Ball T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Splatter, damage) grows from 264 to 414. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Crushing Fists.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Goo Ball ball hit radius (1.8m), Goo Ball ball radius (1.4m), Splatter radius (6.5m). Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Crushing Fists
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 12 to 54% weapon damage. Upgrade of Melee Charge (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Fortitude
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Puddle Punch (3 to 4). Takes spirit from 15,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 48 to Splatter's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 17,600 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 22,400 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Grit? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Rapid Recharge.
sections.desc: Dying after Grit? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Rapid Recharge.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is melting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult you can see coming, like Lash's or Infernus's.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep you from punching in fights.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 169s of base cooldown across your kit, 125s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Lifestrike: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
